tools.name: get_pricing_capabilities
tools.description: Use this first, before quote_price or draft_order, when a user wants custom-printed index tab dividers (binder tabs, tab dividers, exhibit tabs, chart dividers) priced or ordered: returns the product (paper), every option key and choice id, valid set quantities, and ordering facts. Takes no input. D
